subject: function:towerRecordLevelBeaten
value: IMAGE-WIDE CENSUS OF THE SMALL-INSTRUCTION-COUNT-DELTA CLASS, and a negative verdict on it as a harvest lane. METHOD AND SIZE. Filtering report.json to game-category functions with 90 < fuzzy < 100, excluding the pmotion/atree/enemy TUs owned by other lanes, gives 251 candidates over 56 TUs; joining them against per-TU `fndiff --count` yields exactly 77 functions whose |target-ours| instruction delta lies in 1..4 (46 at delta 1, 21 at 2, 8 at 3, 4 at 4). This is the full population the lane was formed to harvest, and it is now enumerated rather than sampled. SCREENING RESULT: 47 of the 77 (61%) already carry a parked, capped, or negative attempt record and are hard vetoes; only 30 are clean. THE CENTRAL FINDING, from reading `fndiff --ops` opcode-multiset signatures for every clean candidate: the class is not a pool of cheap structural wins. It is dominated by three mechanisms that the corpus ALREADY records as source-unreachable or as documented losing trades, and they partition it almost completely. (1) HOME-COPY, both directions, the single largest group: `ours-only -1 mr` with target-only none (MapMusicStart, LoadWorldDone, LoadWorldData, MBOX_BGLoadModelDone, MBOX_LoadModelFixed, dcsReadCalls), and the mirror `target-only +1 mr` with ours-only none (fn_8005D730, fn_8005F0F4), plus target-only `addi rD,rS,0` parameter copies which are the same class in MWCC's copy spelling (GetEnemyType). Governed by claim.law.addr16-lo-address-homed-via-r0-is-source-unreachable.20260831.v1 and, for eligibility, by claim.law.webfrank-cannot-close-a-count-asymmetric-residual.20260831.v1 -- and note that being count-asymmetric is precisely what DEFINES membership in this census, so EVERY function in this lane is WebFrank-ineligible by construction. That is the structural reason the lane cannot be closed by the postprocessor path. (2) INDEX-BASE ASSOCIATION: target `add rBase,rIdx` + displacement against our `addi`+x-form (stwx/lwzx/stfsx) -- SetPlayerStartPos, load_player_model_sub, fn_80051C78, mini_inventory_update, init_enemy_vars, NextAttractWave, player_get_from_save, fn_80057024. Governed by claim.law.direct-global-member-flips-index-base-association.20260831.v1, whose matrix leaves exactly one reachable source form (global symbol + member access) and whose own procedure disqualifies that form whenever the target caches ONE base register and does per-access adds -- which is the shape every instance inspected here has. (3) BRANCH/GOTO-PAIR: target conditional-plus-unconditional pair against MWCC's folded inverse branch, the wall already recorded by the DoAudioTallySFX and FindWORLDOBJ closure caps. PRACTICAL CONSEQUENCE FOR LANE PLANNING. towerRecordLevelBeaten, the 79/78 that closed in one probe and motivated this lane, was NOT representative: its mechanism was the equality-chain range fold (claim.law.inverted-guard-defeats-equality-chain-range-fold.20260831.v1), a genuinely source-reachable front-end folding decision. Scanning all 30 clean candidates for that law's diagnostic tell -- ours-only `addi`+`cmplwi`+`bgt` against target-only `cmpwi`+`beq/bne` -- finds ZERO further instances: that seam was fully harvested by the run that discovered it. A small instruction-count delta is therefore NOT a proxy for a cheap structural win; it is most often the signature of a register-copy or addressing-association decision made below the source level. A LABELLING HAZARD THIS CENSUS EXPOSES, worth fixing on touch across the corpus. Three of these functions were provisionally classified REGISTER_ONLY on the strength of their register-flavoured diffs, and running tools/gdl/regnorm.py (at main's d1ee8eada relocation-row fix) refused that label on ALL THREE: MapMusicStart 68 paired / 1 renaming / 4 STRUCTURAL / 5 unpaired, GetEnemyType 69 / 19 / 13 / 4, fn_80051C78 120 / 22 / 11 / 2, every one STRUCTURAL-PRESENT. In the two pure copy cases every STRUCTURAL row turned out to be a branch-target displacement of exactly the count delta (+4 and -8 respectively) -- the downstream shadow of the surplus instruction rather than an independent gap -- which is precisely why the diffs LOOK register-only and precisely why the label is wrong. This matters beyond bookkeeping: claim.law.webfrank-cannot-close-a-count-asymmetric-residual.20260831.v1 defines count-asymmetric as STRUCTURAL in WebFrank's terms, so a REGISTER_ONLY tag on any member of this census advertises postprocessor eligibility that provably does not exist. Note that claim.law.addr16-lo-address-homed-via-r0-is-source-unreachable.20260831.v1 calls its own instances 'a distinct and recognisable REGISTER_ONLY residual' and routes them to WebFrank; that routing advice is unsafe wherever the instance carries a count delta, and the two laws should be reconciled on next touch. RECOMMENDATION: do not re-run this lane as a generic sweep. The remaining value in these 77 functions is in their STRUCTURAL residuals (branch shape, declared-local count, spill set), which is exactly where claim.law.direct-global-member-flips-index-base-association tells the reader to go once the base-materialization screen fails. Route future count-delta work by MECHANISM SIGNATURE from the outset -- screen `--ops` for a named reachable lever before opening any source file -- rather than by delta magnitude, which this census shows carries almost no information about reachability.
